rules.title: Avoid shared mutable state
rules.text: Avoid shared mutable state; prefer message passing or immutable data.

rules.title: Timeouts everywhere
rules.text: Set explicit timeouts on every network call, lock and queue operation.

rules.title: Support cancellation
rules.text: Propagate cancellation so abandoned work stops.

rules.title: Bounded retries with backoff
rules.text: Retry only idempotent operations, with exponential backoff, jitter and a maximum.

rules.title: Test for races
rules.text: Run race detectors or stress tests when changing concurrent code.

rules.title: Hold locks briefly
rules.text: Hold locks for the shortest time possible and never across I/O.
